name: scenarios
purpose: Small release set of observable robot behaviors crossing real canonical boundaries.

tests.contract: Blocked forward motion can revoke the old objective and produce a bounded escape alternative.
RoomCruise keeps canonical continuous motion semantics across background replans.
Follow keeps canonical continuous motion semantics across background replans.
RoomCruise distinguishes local motion quality from global localization quality.
Encoder process stall/crash preserves source-time truth and fails without invented freshness.
Follow person keeps camera demand/generation ownership and fails closed on capability loss.
Delayed planning remains observable and canonical replay reproduces the bounded execution.
MCAP evidence preserves deterministic full-LiDAR data and indexed query lineage.
Host-side turn revocation requires fresh admission and cannot reuse stale physical state.
